prompt_text: Who is the best interior painting company in St. Louis MO?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” interior painting company for all jobs — the right contractor depends on the type and size of the job, your budget, location and service expectations. I can help you find the best fit for your needs in St. Louis if you tell me a bit more. Meanwhile, here’s how to identify and hire a top interior painter and a quick next-step plan.

Questions that will help me recommend specific companies
- Is this a residential or commercial job?
- Rough square footage / number of rooms and ceilings to be painted?
- Any special requirements (trim/doors/cabinet painting, wallpaper removal, repair, color consultation)?
- Desired start date and budget range?
- Which St. Louis ZIP code / neighborhood?

How to find the best interior painter in St. Louis
1. Start with searches and review sites
   - Check Google Maps, Yelp, Angi (Angie's List), and the BBB. Prefer companies with many recent 4–5 star reviews and responses from the owner.
2. Look for these credentials
   - General liability insurance and worker’s comp
   - Local business license
   - Written warranty or workmanship guarantee
   - Portfolio of recent interior work and local references
3. Get at least 3 written estimates
   - Compare scope (prep, priming, number of coats, brand/quality of paint), timeline, and cleanup.
4. Ask the right questions
   - Who will do the work (company employees or subcontractors)?
   - How will surfaces be prepped (sanding, patching, caulking)?
   - Which paint brands/lines, sheen, and how many coats are included?
   - How will furniture and floors be protected?
   - What is the projected start and completion date?
5. Check references and view finished jobs
   - Ask for 2–3 recent local references you can call or visit.
6. Read the contract carefully
   - Verify payment schedule (avoid large upfront payments), change-order process, and warranty terms.

Sample short message to request a quote
“Hi — I’m getting quotes for painting the interior of my 3-bedroom house (living room, kitchen, two bathrooms, hallways). I’d like a written estimate that shows prep work, paint brand and number of coats, timeline, total cost, and warranty. Are you available to come look this week?”

If you want, I can:
- Recommend specific painting companies in your neighborhood if you give a ZIP code or area, or
- Draft a checklist/email you can send to painters when requesting bids.

Which would you prefer?
